title: Asahina Mafuyu — Walls Closing In〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(That's all of my homework...
I've reviewed everything else, so I just need to go to sleep now...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<No, Yuki, we're glad you're here.
The lyrics you wrote were incredibly good.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I agree! Oh, also!
What font do you wanna use for your lyrics?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Slow down, Amia. Don't my illustrations come first?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I know, but it's still good to ask, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Oh, I might want to message them before I do...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Sorry for not responding sooner, but I won't be able to do anything today. I'll try working on my lyrics tomorrow if I have time.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I need to find some time to work on my lyrics...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That's okay. In the meantime, I'll keep working on our song.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I drew a rough sketch based on the theme we chose, so I'll send it over to you. K said it was okay, but let me know if it's not what you were going for...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <We've still got plenty of work left to do, so don't worry! You work at your own pace, Yuki!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I need to get to school a little early tomorrow...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (The class representatives are supposed to create a summary of their ideas and submit it to the teachers. After that...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (A chat message...? Oh, it's from Mizuki...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What if you logged onto Nightcord to work on stuff while you're at school during lunch?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But I have student council business to take care of during lunch. Also, the teachers are always asking for my help...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I don't know if that's going to work...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Various people are always asking for my help during the day.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But thank you for making this suggestion.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(They're trying to accommodate me.
They want to work with me...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (That gesture alone is more than enough...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What if you said you want to use your school's studying room to work on your cram school assignments and stuff?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Can't you log into Nightcord on your phone and act like you're doing your homework?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Mafuyu, you listen to us chatting while responding through text.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But it could be worth a try.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Let's just try it once to see!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<Then, I'll talk to you all tomorrow.
We can talk again during lunch.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I'll need to keep my lunch free tomorrow.)
